seo_title: Beat the Marketplaces: B2B & B2C Transactional SEO
seo_desc: Recover your sales from the giants. Combine Core Web Vitals, Schema, and CRO to dominate your organic sales funnel with high purchase intent keywords.
author_pitch: I am Jacinto, CEO of Lanza Estudio. My approach goes beyond traffic: I build complete conversion architectures. By directly integrating payment gateways in production environments and automating business processes, I ensure every SEO visit transforms into tangible revenue for your business.
title: The Big Fish Hijack: How to Stop Marketplaces from Stealing Your Organic Sales
body:
Are your clients searching for your flagship product but ending up buying on Amazon or an industrial directory?

You invest months creating an exceptional product and attracting clicks, but when the user types in high purchase intent keywords, giant marketplaces monopolize the top results. Your company is pushed to the bottom of the page, losing thousands of dollars daily in direct sales and surrendering control of your organic sales funnel to third parties that charge abusive commissions.

The trap of competing for volume

Trying to beat internet giants with basic ranking techniques is digital suicide. They have more authority, but you have specialization. If your page lacks the extreme speed demanded by Core Web Vitals metrics or fails to clarify its offer, the user will bounce to the easiest option. Traffic without technical trust is just a vanity metric that lines your competitors' pockets.

Our solution: Hybrid Transactional Shielding

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we do not fight for volume; we fight for absolute profitability. We implement a reverse engineering strategy focused on transactional search intent, isolating your true buyers through micro-optimizations that large portals cannot personalize.

  1. Advanced Structured Data (Schema) Deployment: We mark up your inventory and services with real-time availability and price microdata, snatching visual clicks on the search engine results pages.
  2. Surgical Attack with Long Tail SEO: We identify and dominate specific niche searches that marketplaces ignore, capturing clients in the final decision phase.
  3. Fusion with Local SEO for business: We geolocate your B2B or B2C offer so that immediate proximity and availability outperform the impersonal shipping of aggregators.
  4. Extreme Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): We redesign your landing pages focusing on Core Web Vitals to eliminate any friction right before checkout.

The Real Impact on Direct Profitability

  • Recovery of profit margins: By selling directly through your organic channel, you eliminate intermediary commissions and retain 100% of the transaction.
  • Mastery of purchase intent: You only attract users who are ready to enter their credit card, drastically reducing the customer acquisition cost.
  • Building an independent digital asset: Your domain becomes an autonomous sales machine, protected against algorithm changes from external directories.
